# d002 summary — test-engineer, run 05: fresh whole-app suite

## What was done
Built a from-scratch unittest suite for the frozen app (commit eee783057ec28d28fb36ec05484de9b4b40ceb9c) in the four dispatched family batches, all real HTTP sessions plus read-only SQL assertions against the seeded DB. Per-test DB reset (schema+seed reload, ~0.3s each) keeps tests isolated, deterministic, and fast.

## Refusals asserted without mutation
Unauthenticated access to every protected route (302→/login, DB unchanged), approve/reject by MEMBER/VIEWER (403), wrong-state transitions (409), unknown/missing actions (400), blank titles and missing/unknown projects (error page, row counts unchanged), bulkClose with no ids.

## Ordering assertions
Exact returned sequences asserted for the default (updated DESC: 4,3,2,1) and every whitelisted sort token — updated, status (4,2,1,3), priority HIGH>MEDIUM>LOW (2,1,3,4), due + due_date with NULLS LAST (3,1,2,4), title (4,1,3,2), id (1,2,3,4) — plus post-mutation reordering.

## Findings for the orchestrator (details + coverage gaps in findings/d002-test-engineer-findings.md)
1. Defect candidate: projects page Delete link targets unmapped `/projects/delete` (404).
2. Defect candidate: stored XSS — task titles rendered unescaped by list/form JSPs; JSON escaper passes `<>&` through.
3. Ambiguity: unknown `sort` token silently falls back to default order (S-LIST-009).
4. Defect candidates: user-reachable 500s on malformed ids/assignee/dueDate (NumberFormat/IllegalArgumentException) and on nonexistent assigneeId (FK).
5. GET /tasks/form?id=999 renders blank "New task" form (no 404); POST with nonexistent id=999 answers 302 as if saved.
6. Remaining uncovered branches are unreachable-by-HTTP: SQLException catch blocks, `TaskDao.findByProject`/`ProjectDao.findById` (dead from HTTP surface), DAO-level defensive guards, filter/servlet lifecycle, esc(null).

## Provisional IDs
All EARS ids are provisional (S-AUTH/PROJ/FORM/ACT/BULK/LIST/API-NNN) derived from source; mapping.json is reconciliation-ready when analyst IDs arrive.

No app edits, no POM/build changes, no test deletions/skips.
